shared_elements: figures with arms extended forward/holding objects
offerings or vessels held or presented
registers with human figures aligned on a groundline
low relief carving with incised interior detail (garment lines, hair)
figures facing one another in an offering/presentation encounter
justification: Both show profile human figures in low relief, aligned on a common groundline, facing one another with arms extended and objects/vessels presented between them, an offering-presentation scheme rendered with flat outlines and incised interior detail. However, A shows seated figures at a laden offering table beneath registers of small sign-like glyphs, with squat proportions, whereas B shows tall standing figures in long fringed garments with elaborately dressed hair and no accompanying script band, and their proportions and detailing of hair and drapery follow different conventions.
